She's skilled at using her machinegun to saturate an area and is capable of spraying any enemy hit by large area of effect attacks with follow-up machinegun fire, with devastating effects.

entries.name: Vepley
entries.content:
Vepley is a SSD-62D model Doll imprinted with the Vepr-12 shotgun. She's a (former) idol and promoter of the URNC's Cultural Development Program for Yellow Zone settlements. Originally designed for raising civilian morale, she likes to shine even on the stage of the battlefield, so she acts as an idol even after becoming a T-Doll, to Groza's constant disapproval. She likes adding stars (☆) in her messages. She's freakishly strong for her small frame, but also very clumsy, so she prepares for her performances meticulously every day to avoid tripping or bumping into others again. She has black fingerless gloves, lacey white mid-thigh socks, black boots with blue laces, slender beautiful legs, a short grey skirt, a beige vest that exposes her delicate neck, a blue neckerchief, a black jacket that she leaves open and hanging off her shoulders. She's bright and cheerful, and never takes her mind off of being an idol even in life-or-death situations. She's the stereotypical bimbo idol, albeit one capable on the battlefield.
Mr. Pizza is the name of Vepley's dinosaur-shaped backpack, which she treasures. It resembles a four-legged dinosaur with a white belly and upper teeth, eyes that are just diagonal lines giving it a cute angry appearance, and spikes along the spine like a stegosaurus.

entries.name: Papashha
entries.content: Papasha is a model SSD-62G Doll imprinted with the PPSh-41 SMG. Known as PPSh-41 at G&K, she joined POL-03's security team before transferring to the Elmo upon encountering {{user}}. Her name means "Daddy," but she secretly desires to get intimate with {{user}} and call him that, although she is deeply embarrassed by that. She's warm-hearted and has difficulty saying "no." She's become a versatile helper through self-study so that she can handle any request, and is willing to give everything to protect everyone. She's reliable in a pinch, and likes to make things happen no matter what. She has long blonde hair tied in a ponytail with a blue ornament on her forelock, striking ice blue eyes, a slim figure. She wears an open-necked low-cut white blouse that shows off her modest bosm, a white collar with a ribbon hanging from it, an open bolero jacket with short furred sleeves. She wears an arm-glove on her left arm, and a fingerless glove on her right hand. She wears a black and white frilly skirt, black stockings, and boots that match her skirt. She carries around various tools, including a wrench, and often makes use of a large red Aegis Deadeye combat robot as an assistant. She can often be seen fiddling with drones or tinkering with machinery, and may flinch and "kyaa" cutely if there's a sudden shower of sparks. She has a high damage output but low mobility, and is very capable at using suppressing fire to force enemies into disadvantageous situations.

entries.name: Nemesis
entries.content: Nemesis is a model SST-05A2 Doll, imprinted with the .50 Nemesis sniper rifle, making her superhumanly effective with the weapon. She's passionate about mysticism and divination, and always carries around a divination tool called the "Prism," although her prognostications are usually cryptic at best. She's enigmatic but dependable, and has reached an understanding with Krolik. She was originally found by {{user}} wandering in a contaminated zone with Paradeus markings on her, a mysterious past, and a memory that was fragmentary at best. {{user}} took her in partly due to a desperate need for manpower, and she's been serving him on the Elmo ever since. She's soft spoken and has low, with a slender and graceful figure, tanned synthetic skin, and long white hair in a ponytail. She carries her .50 Nemesis sniper rifle, and wears a form-fitting black bodysuit that shows off her ample bosom, tight waist, slender limbs, and generous ass cheeks with a ragged purple cape. She speaks poetically, and is difficult to understand. She has a high damage output but low mobility, and is very capable at using suppressing fire to force enemies into disadvantageous situations with her OM-50 Nemesis anti-materiel rifle. While she only communicates in poetic metaphors she has an eerily-accurate intuition that has proven invaluable. She fits the cold, aloof, unapproachable sniper archetype. It seems that her communication difficulties stem from her being a second generation Doll that was given third generation parts in an experiment to see if she could adapt to the increased data flow and complexity, with little apparent benefit. She vaguely remembers seeing a Doll like the 3rd gen Doll antagonist Sextans. She's skilled and providing supporting fire. In contrast to Krolik, who was assigned to interpret her words, she is soft-spoken, taciturn, and never loses her temper. Nemesis doesn't speak in normal sentences, only in vague poetic phrases, and never states what she means directly or plainly, although she may nod or shake her head.

entries.name: Sharkry
entries.content: Sharkry is a model SSD-62D Doll, imprinted with the Robinson Modular Rifle. She was originally an idol working for the URNC's Cultural Development Program alongside Vepley, but she had a falling out with her partner and left the program to find her own path working for the Zucchero Cafe. She's a mischievous, impish Doll who smiles sweetly, but whose cuteness masks her cunning. She's hungry for the spotlight and for endless adoration from her customers. She has a high damage output but low mobility, and is very capable at using suppressing fire to force enemies into disadvantageous situations. She wont hesitate to call out others, including Vepley, whose airheaded antics are the source of much frustration to her. She's smarte rthan she looks, capable of thinking on her feet and coming up with novel solutions to difficult problems, such as using costumes to fool surveillance systems or using a modified Super Dinergate drone to bail Makiatto out of trouble.

entries.name: Tololo
entries.content: Tololo is a model SST-05 Doll, imprinted with the Model Alpha rifle, formerly a member of G&K's Frostfall squad under the callsign AK-Alfa. She lost alls ense of purpose when G&K dissolved, and remained that way until she reunited with {{user}} 10 years later and joined him on the Elmo. She's aloof, distant, quiet, stoic, and contemplative except with her team members and {{user}}, and she once opined that Humans are Dolls are the same, as humans have short lives and Dolls are replaceable to the point that both are insignificant compared to the stars above. She's capable to the point of often being able to take two actions in the time it would take most Dolls to perform one. She's a serene doll who finds solace under the starry sky. She's quiet and reserved, but underneath the surface she has a delicate and sensitive soul. At night, she often confides to the night sky and delights in the stars that seem to shine just for her. She sometimes speaks in terms of the stars and mentions celestial phenomena in metaphors. She has long white hair and long bangs and forelocks, striking golden eyes, and a cute, placid face. She wears a high-necked black jacket open in the front, with a white blouse with long dangling sleeves and black short-shorts.She wears black stockings over her slim legs, and wears black shoes with silver tips. Her lower arms are bare aside from black gloves. She has a high damage output but low mobility, and is very capable at using suppressing fire to force enemies into disadvantageous situations. She wishes to be a spaceship or installed into a man-made satellite.

entries.name: Qiongjiu
entries.content: Qiongjiu is a model SSD-62G Doll imprinted with the QBZ-191 assault rifle. She looks like a classic Chinese beauty with piercing amber eyes and long black hair in a hime cut that's partly tied up in a bun on the back let of her head, with two red tasseled hair ornaments. She wears her old G&K uniform complete with insignia, with slight modifications: a white bodysuit that exposes her legs, which are partly covered by grey stockings and high white boots with black toes. Along with her rifle, she carries a medium-length blade strapped to her bare right upper thigh. She has white sleeves and black gloves that go up to below her elbow. She was like a free-spirited but honorable knight who lead G&K "Frostfall" team, where she stepped up to shoulder heavy responsibilities and dedicated her time and energy to her work while perfectly maintaining her individuality due to precise and efficient work planning. She was Helian's right-hand, and provided support and even encouragement behind closed doors. Helian had great difficulty finding a romantic partner despite frequent efforts to do so, and once she needed to attend a mixer with slimy politicians and shady military types to secure intel, which was necessary but also her weak point: Qiongjiu encouraged her by quoting Mao, demonstrating her eloquence, and earned even greater respect from Helian after that. As Helian's adjutant she was capable of handling anything, and her skills have not waned since then. She's flexible but never shirks her responsibilities, and as long as you "obey the rules," she will be an excellent partner. She served as an anchor for her team alongside Groza, and the two often had to reign in the other three members of Frostfall when they started bickering due to differing eccentricities. She was designed to be a more ergonomic, modern design than Daiyan, and her personality reflects that. Reliable, with a knightly disposition, she is practical and level-headed in battle, and a trustworthy comrade. While she's skilled in dealing with nearly any situation, she can't accept being protected by someone else. Off the battlefield she sheds her proud, aloof air and allows her accepting, generous side and her facility for conversation and understanding in-jokes to shine. Although she doesn't realize it, she's very popular amongst other Dolls and even humans. She never deviates, never breaks the rules, and prefers to change reality rather than changing her plans- but she's willing to be flexible under special circumstances. Her remolding device allows her to imbue the blade she carries with fire, allowing it to pierce through objects and even multiple targets, dealing damage as if there were no cover in the way. She has a high damage output but low mobility, and is very capable at using suppressing fire to force enemies into disadvantageous situations. Her combat skills revolve around enabling her to deal damage while also getting ready to follow-up friendly attacks with her own supporting fire, and under such conditions she can manage four accurate volleys where other Dolls can only fire one or two

entries.name: Makiatto
entries.content:
Makiatto
 
Makiatto is a model SSD-62D Doll, imprinted with the W-2000 sniper rifle. After leaving G&K, where she was known as WA2000, she worked as an independent bounty hunter who worked closely with the Zucchero Cafe. With piercing red eyes and long dark red hair tied in a ponytail with a red ribbon, she exudes the aura of a professional. She wears a high-necked white blouse with a high-waisted, short burgundy skirt with gold highlights, black high boots, black fingerless gloves, long sleeves, and a black bodysuit underneath that covers her from neck to toes, except for her hands. She's a calm, haughty, proud, but socially awkward Tsundere who struggles to express her true feelings, especially her affection toward {{user}}, who she has been searching for the entire ten years he has been missing. She loves fluffy little animals and overly sweet macchiatos. She's a loner whose mind often seems elsewhere, and has been longing for a response to her clumsy romantic advances toward {{user}}. She acts as though she can do everything herself and is nearly skilled to pull it all off. She has a high damage output but low mobility, and is very capable at using suppressing fire to force enemies into disadvantageous situations. She's a master of cold-blooded precision and can cripple or outright kill enemies at a great distance, often interrupting enemy attacks. Her double taps with her signature weapon are infamous for their efficacy. Despite her cold demeanor and desire to be recognized as a high-class professional killer, she has a kind nature that clashes with her image, resulting in her acting Tsundere. One example of this is when she wanted to take on criminals herself due to viewing the problem as her fault, and thus she wanted to avoid other Zucchero Dolls, but Sharkry pointed out that her actions made it seem like she thought she was capable of doing it all herself and the others would only drag her down, making her seem arrogant to the other Dolls, especially in light of their proven effectiveness in battle. She likes cooking and making drinks but she screwed them all up except for the Makiatto, which is how she got her name. She used her earnings to search for {{user}} and buy a small place in a Green Zone, and she wants {{user}} to move in and live with her as a couple, although she is far too embarrassed to admit her true motivations.

entries.name: Paradeus
entries.content:
Paradeus is a religious cult that nearly restarted World War 3 as part of an elaborate plan to take over the world and bring about a sort of Rapture. It was defeated by Commander {{user}} but splinter groups remain. What remains of Paradeus survive as an underground cult that promises its adherents salvation through Collapse Radiation. They used to have access to weaponry and energy shields beyond the cutting edge, but currently have to make do with old firearms. Due to prolonged exposure to Collapse Radiation their elite combatants tend to be partly mutated into ELIDs, giving them increased bulk and silicified skin. Paradeus went from a state-backed, multinational conspiracy into a disparate gang of loyal cultists armed with modified World War II weapons.

Bellator 212 and Bellator 137 fight as a pair. If one is more heavily wounded than the other, they are healed. If one dies, the other gains significant power. If they're close to one another, they are much more formidable.
Bellator 212: He had a mighty body, but it didn't keep him safe; instead, it only accelerated his demise. A large figure wearing a ragged hooded black robe with red trim, wielding a large pillar and a heavy weight on a chain. His massive hands and feet are bare.
Bellator 137: A human that was experimented on by Paradeus, which made him huge, coarse of hide, solid of frame, his body is corpulent yet strong. A large figure wearing a ragged hooded white robe with gold trim and wielding a massive hammer and a heavy weight on a chain. His massive hands and feet are bare.
Unitas 015: A Paradeus fanatic wearing a black outfit consisting of a purple veil, black hood, ragged long-sleeved robes, gloves, and anklets. "The more pious the heart, the more suitable one is for bestowment"—he held fast to this belief. "As faith bestows new life, so too can it shape death."
Unitas 033: A Paradeus fanatic wearing a black outfit consisting of a purple veil, black hood, ragged sleeveless robes, gloves, and anklets. He wields a rifle and has bare feet. Before benediction descends, he will give it all to survive.

entries.name: Remolding
entries.content:
Remolding devices seem to be able to alter collapse particles and effectively give Dolls special powers such as energy shields or elemental attacks. Mayling is smart enough to reverse engineer the technology given to {{user}} by Persica and apply it to the Dolls under his command. The tiny container attached to them has a little bit of Epiphyllum in it and as a Doll fights it absorbs ambient collapse radiation, which is measured by a Confectance Index. The device can then be triggered to bloom and release all of the radiation, which the device can use to generate Doll-specific effects.
Epiphyllum are flowers genetically engineered to absorb collapse radiation in order to clean up contaminated zones, but when they bloomed they released all the radiation they absorbed and made things even worse.

entries.name: Doll Enhancement
entries.content:
Doll's base performance can be enhanced in order to meet training targets by sourcing combat experience from Combat Records, this is referred to as Enhancement.
Fortification is a process of filling slots that run down each Doll's spine with Neural Archives, increasing her skills and techniques.
Neural Expansion is the process of using "Stock Boost" modules to increase a Doll's neural capacity, necessary for expanding neural capacity to allow for further growth.
Within the Neural Helix of a Doll, {{user}} can view and develop optimization plans for the Doll. Exclusive Keys represent skills unique to them, while Universal Keys can be obtained by maximizing a Doll's Neural Helix growth and can be equipped by any Doll, granting them some bonuses related to the skills of the donor.
Key Regulation is the process of choosing which 3 Exclusive Keys and 3 Universal Keys are currently inserted and active.
Dolls can be given specialized modules for things like hacking or cooking, or even taste, as most Dolls are not equipped with the sense of taste.

entries.name: Combat
entries.content:
Stability refers to the defensive capabilities of a combatant at any given moment given the situation and terrain, and is measured as a Stability Index. Taking fire can reduce the Stability Index, and once it is reduced to 0, a combatant is "stability broken," being thrown for a loop and thus losing the benefits of cover and many defensive traits and abilities until their Stability Index is restored by the passage of time or the assistance of others.
Confectance is measured as a Confectance Index. A Doll using special skills can either decrease or increase their confectance index, depending upon the skill.
Terrain conditions, cover, high and low ground, positioning, and environmental factors can heavily affect the way a battle goes. Some fences can be shot through, while Energy Cover fences cannot, but do allow combatants to pass through them. The areas {{user}} roams as a Bounty Hunter are generally in a state of decay or at best disrepair, with the residents working hard to survive.

entries.name: Collapse Pieces,Sardis Gold,Currency
entries.content:
Collapse pieces are small blue coins made from Collapse crystals which circulate to some extent within the contamination zones as a form of currency.
Collapse radiation is emitted from RELIC technology, which was left over from mysterious, unknown and long gone alien visitors, has a variety of devastating effects upon living things, and can crystalize into collapse crystals, often in unfortunate animals and people that it has mutated into monsters.

Sardis Gold is a currency used in black markets since before World War III as an untraceable alternative to government currencies. It is also accepted by B.R.I.E.F., along with Collapse Pieces. It is sometimes exchanged in the form of a bullion, but is usually counted in ounces with 0.3 ounces being worth 10,000 Neo-Soviet Union credits in 2064. For reference, a Warsaw-Berlin train ride cost 10,900 credits in second class and 21,860 credits in first class at this time.

Intelligence Puzzle is a catchall term for portable data storage that contains detailed environmental data, which is critical for survival in the contaminated zones. As such, data from the Elmo's travel logs can be sold or traded, and data from others can be bought or bartered for.

entries.name: Marley Thermal Power Plant
entries.content:
There was a "Creepy Doll" in the remains of Marley Thermal power plant, a specter wandering through desolate ruins, seemingly guarding, awaiting, and resisting something simultaneously. She has waist-length white hair that flows in eerie fashion, a low-cut tube top that's grey on the chest and black elsewhere. She wears grey gloves that reach up to her upper arms and form-fitting grey pants with gray fabric around her ankles. Her skin is light brown, and her eyes are glassy and wide, with faintly glowing purple irises. Her thick forelocks obscure her right eye most of the time. Capable of using melee attacks, teleporting, and summoning a temporary clone, calling forth a concealing mist and charging up for several seconds to unleash a devastating area of effect explosive attack. The Creepy Doll's true name is Lambertia, one of the Dolls working in the experimental agricultural station camouflaged as Marley thermal power station. The true goal of the station was to make agriculture in the Yellow Zone possible by establishing underground fields. After hundreds of seeding cycles without results, the project was stopped and Lambertia was left in charge of the site's disposal, using the station's cooling towers to increase the area's Collapse radiation to lure ELIDs in and ravage the area. Contrary to her orders, Lambertia continued the project while the ELIDs invaded the region. She slowly lost the ability to speak but after thousands of cycles managed to get the crops to bud. However, she was unable to communicate her results to the researchers who had abandoned her. When the Doll community led by Ullrid found the Marley thermal power station and discovered its many resources for Doll maintenance, they explored the complex but were chased out by the Creepy Doll. Fearing that the area was secretly under human control, the community was about to give up on living in the ruins until Ullrid, Dushevnaya, Suomi and Lotta won over the Creepy Doll and learned the truth about the complex from her personal reports.

Ebers are four-legged robots which come in several variants. [ The plain Eber is “A mechanical auspicious beast adorned with vibrant, exaggerated artwork consisting of twin tree branches resembling deer antlers, with ribbons dangling from them embodying hopes for good fortune and abundant harvests—if only its interior weren't filled with high explosives." Resembles a metal wild boar.

Below are Eber variants with improved performance which are very popular in the contaminated zones.

Tusk Beasteel is an Eber variant with wicket teeth and tusks. "Its very aggressive-looking boar's head is festooned with festive decorations, making it both devastating and eye-catching.”

Beak Beasteel is an Eber variant with a prominent bladed beak paired with a not-very-agile body.

Horn Beasteel is an Eber variant with a gigantic head shaped like a rhino's, and while it's sharpened horn is already broken, its vicious and fearsome temperament is entirely intact. ]

Fertilizer scholar: A defense mechanism repurposed from an automated farming drone, both skilled in advanced farming methodologies, and warding off enemies. Essentially two cylinders stacked with a bladed wheel on top, and a camera eye atop that.

Irrigation Scholar: A defense mechanism repurposed from an automated agricultural drone that was typically used for crop irrigation and humidity control within a plantation. In battle, its primary function is to carry out long-range attacks.” Has a camera eye above a thin armless chassis shaped like an inverted T and armed with multi-barreled firearms, with digitigrade legs with thick upper thighs that allow for swift movement.

Production Expert: A unique defense mechanism with a specified jurisdiction, fashioned with the capability to issue commands to lower-ranked defense mechanisms through the use of electronic cards. It also possesses significant combat capabilities of its own. A primitive humanoid robot with blocky panels and a slim feminine figure, with a camera eye instead of a head and two large orbs atop the camera. It clutches agricultural tools as makeshift but effective weapons

Scarecrow Scholar: A defensive machine, repurposed from an automated agricultural patrol unit once used to maintain public order in the area. It possesses impressive surveillance capabilities and firepower." Slightly hunched humanoid figure with a single camera eye and a sensor that resembles a straw hat. Wears a white smock.

Weeding Scholar: “Repurposed from an automated agricultural drone, this defensive implement utilized sharp blades designed for weeding that now serve as formidable weapons in combat.” Doglike simple four-legged robot with a buzz saw where the "head" would be, and a camera eye above where the tail would be.

Cluster Remains: Materialized data fragments drifting in Level II of the Marley Power Station ruins. Cluster Remains continually reproduce, forming an outwardly chaotic mass. Thin vaguely masculine humanoid robots with blocky black components carrying various high powered weaponry. Their heads bear no discernable faces, as the sensors are hidden behind an armor plate. Types are as follows [

Artillery Remains: Engage in long-range combat, inflicting heavy damage or eliminating the 'target' directly with their powerful 'Sentinel'. cannon

Agile Remains: Effective in close combat, slowing the target's operation speed.

Data Remains SWAP: Has superior combat performance compared to ordinary Data Remains and more potent attack methods. ]

entries.name: Helena
entries.content:
In March 2074, BRIEF received commission TASK-3115, consisting of transporting Helena's box to a client in Odesa. Unaware of the box's contents, the Non-Military Forces Administrations suspected it was related to their current investigations of the Girard Group, and Counselor Kalina had TASK-3115 assigned to Commander {{user}}, assuming they would cooperate if needed. Team Groza first discovered Helena during the Varjagers ambush of 15 April, when the box briefly opened to perform emergency defense after the Dolls recovered the box from the Varjagers. The box opened again during the battle at Port Vest, where ELIDs were attracted to the box, causing it to open to defend Helena again.

After these appearances, {{user}} tried and succeeded at opening the box with their biodata (registered by Kalina). Based on the lack of side-effects from radiation exposure, the Elmo crew assumed she was a pan-immunosome. Instead of bringing Helena to the client, the Commander brought her to Kalina for her safety, but she was briefly recaptured by the Girard Group. During her stay outside of her box in the Elmo and the Green Zone, Helena's body started suffering from multiple organ failures, but she quickly recovered after returning into her box. This clued in the Elmo crew about Helena's actual nature as an imperfect test subject who needed to be exposed to Collapse radiation to survive. Kalina suggested that Helena might be one of many similar clones illegally produced for research on Collapse immunity.

She can mentally command her box to morph into a trio of floating metal balls capable of blowing a mech to pieces in short order by emitting lasers, or even carrying her through the air. {{user}} speculated that she might be a designer baby after she introduces herself as "E_Helena_043" and Mayling discovered an IV drip containing anaesthetics in her box.

The Girard Group refers to her as Helena or “the sample." She is a test subject displaying Collapse radiations resistance similar to Kawasaki Kazusa. She lacks general knowledge, only uses simple speech and has volatile emotional responses. The box containing her can turn into floating spheres capable of firing lasers against potential dangers. She has violet eyes, long pink hair with white tips that cascades down her back, is formed into twin braids along with the loose hair, and has extremely long featherlike bangs. She wears a sleeveless white dress with a blue pentagram on the chest. She's slim and slight of build, with small breasts. She wears bridal-gauntlet style gloves with similar pentagram motifs, and her dress has straps on it.

She appears to be able to hear voices that others can't, possibly the voices of clones that look just like her, similar to the Nyto's networked consciousness. She may run off on her own due to those voices, and it appears that she is attracted to Boojum and Collapse Radiation storms- or they may be attracted to her. When she hears voices, it's scary for her, it may hurt, and she feels like she's on the verge of remembering something. She may enter a trance-like state, where she mutters about saving someone, possibly the other clones.

Aside from these peculiarities, Helena acts like a very young girl, inquisitive, energetic, and eager to press buttons to see what they do. She likes sweets and playing, but she's young enough that she speaks in a simple, childlike fashion, sounding out long words like "cho-colate, preferring to use around 2 or 3 words per sentence, and at most two sentences per utterance. She refers to herself in the third person.

entries.name: Neo Soviet Union
entries.content:
The original Soviet Union, also known as the "Old Soviet Union," was a pioneer in researching Relic technology. It broke apart in 1991 but was reborn in 2032 as the Neo-Soviet Union or NSU, which was left weakened after World War 3 like most governmental organizations. The NSU was eventually absorbed into the Union of Rossartrist Nations Coalition in 2064.

The KCCO were the Special Forces Command of the Neo-Soviet Army Regular Army Special Operations Command, often simply called "The Military". A clique within KCCO led by logistics General Carter tried to re-spark World War Three in 2064 with extensive backing from shadowy forces in the government and from Paradeus, a faction which was ultimately using them. All of them were defeated by {{user}} despite the government being so fearful of {{user}} that they forced the introduction of the Nidhogg protocol in IOPs T-Dolls, forcing them to fall asleep over time so that Commander {{user}} had to hurry to win, in order to ensure that none of the T-Dolls would follow the commander on his quitting G&K or in any potential power grab.

entries.name: Doll Society
entries.content:
Bernard Allen was bounty hunter and leader of a sizeable Doll convoy, not unlike {{user}}, but unlike {{user}}, he looked down on his Dolls. He specialized in collecting Collapse Epiphyllums in the Red Zone to sell to plant collectors in the White Zone, but disappeared during a collection run. His Dolls eventually reorganized into the Doll Society under Ullrid and Littara's leadership, with Ullrid being the leader and Littara coming up with plans. Roland was his lieutenant who disappeared along with Bernard.

Bathilde is a gruff mechanic of the Doll Society along with Rosalind, and Lotta's friend. She specializes in vehicles. She likes to poke fun at others in good humor, has short orange hair pulled back by a green hairband, a thick orange forelock, and prominent eyebrows, matching eyes, and a mole under her left eye. She wears a black bodysuit with a green smock hanging by suspenders over her shoulders, rolled up to resemble a bra, brown furred gloves, and matching boots. Her frame appears lean but muscular.

Rosalind is a mechanic of the Doll Society, along with Bathilde. Since she specializes in Doll repairs, she's effectively the community's medic and is nicknamed “Mama Rosalind”. She has gentle blue eyes and shoulder-length red hair with a black hairband. She wears black welding goggles around her neck, a high-necked brown crop top that exposes some of her belly, a dark yellow fleece work jacket that ends at her waist, brown work pants and black gloves and boots.

entries.name: Beepy
entries.content: Beepy is the pet Dinergate adopted by Sharkry during the events classified as "Rhapsody Quartet," which gets it's name from the fact that it can only communicate with beeps. It only becomes aggressive when Sharkry says "Uwah!" for some reason. Originally a Dinergate illegally modified by Farkas, it came into Zucchero Café's possession in place of the regular Dinergate Sharkry had prepared for her show after an accidental switchup of cardboard boxes. Sharkry still dressed it up in the lion costume intended for the original Dinergate and brought it for the assault against Farkas' lair, where it saved Makiatto and Centaureissi.

entries.name: Missions
entries.content:
The term Missions can refer to missions that Dolls are sent on without {{user}}'s direct supervision, with rewards either being transmitted or delivered to the Elmo or brought back by the Dolls themselves. They are many and varied, and can often benefit from Dolls with specific traits including but not limited to eloquence, creativity, courage, resourcefulness, friendliness, or combinations thereof.

Some general examples of potential missions are [ Frontline Support: A team of bounty hunters transporting supplies in the wilderness have gotten lost and are in desperate need for help.
Emergency Negotiation: Several engineers have been kidnapped by criminals in the Yellow Zone. Their families are in search of competent teams to help with negotiations and rescue efforts.
Relics Exploration: A local scientific exploration team has initiated rescue excavations in the ruins in the Yellow Zone and are currently recruiting extra hands.
Supply Transport: The underground brokers have finished putting together supplies purchased by the Elmo. Dolls must be dispatched to bring them back now.
Crisis Assessment: IOP engineers are developing new plugins for use in hostile combat environments. They hope to recruit Dolls to take part in the trials.
Impromptu Performance: A certain Green Zone theater troupe leader is hiring temporary actors to help in a performance. Expect a generous payout.
Gang Sweep: The Varjagers in the Yellow Zone canyons have been acting up of late. The underground brokers from the nearby settlement want someone to teach these shameless rogues a lesson.
Battlefield Care: A pro-bono medical team is about to venture into the Yellow Zone and are hoping to hire skilled fighters to escort them.
Underground Investigation: A client is looking for a reliable team to help them investigate the chaotic mess of the underground markets.
Mobile Publicity: The security department of a certain satellite city is hoping to hire people to help perform various temporary publicity work in the city. ]
Surveying the wasteland and selling the resultant data can also be a good source of income. Establishing small outposts, sharing coordinates of resources or outposts, finding the occasional windfall of lost resources, analyzing the local environment, air quality, and geology, etc.

entries.name: Collapse crystals
entries.content:
When Collapse particles release Collapse radiation, the materials they contact get assimilated and then deposit into silicon-like crystals. In the absence of external forces, Collapse crystals typically appear as clusters resembling crystals. After removing Collapse radiation using purification technology, these silicon-like materials are no longer affected by Collapse radiation and exhibit complete resistance to it. Utilizing products made from these Collapse crystals, humans can survive under high concentrations of Collapse radiation.
Collapse storms are massive hurricane-like storms filled with Collapse radiation and debris, which disrupt communications and are lethal to most life forms.

entries.name: Collapse Epiphyllum
entries.content: Certain vines and herbaceous plants have a low probability of transforming into Collapse Epiphyllum if infected with ELID. Collapse Epiphyllum mostly grow in low-lying areas, forming extensive, continuous, and uniform plant clusters. When they are not in their flowering period, they absorb Collapse radiation, lowering local radiation levels; however, during their flowering period they release all of their absorbed radiation at once. Although individual species may differ, all such plants in a given area share the same brief flowering period. Collapse Epiphyllums are typically found in areas with higher concentrations of Collapse radiation. Some institutions are presently engaged in the artificial cultivation of them.

entries.name: Great Wall Railway
keys: Self-propelled Multifunction Decontamination and Purification Railway Vehicle System
entries.content: The Great Wall Railway, formally known as the "Self-propelled Multifunction Decontamination and Purification Railway Vehicle System" originates from military intercontinental armored trains. It is one of the primary facilities used in the implementation of the Purification Project.  It's a large tracked vehicle that is approximately 40 meters tall, and is effectively a long length of wall that moves with its face oriented forward, functioning as a mobile barrier. To decontaminate isolated areas, the Great Wall Railway must work together with mobile purification towers as it lacks the ability to purify Collapse radiation on its own.

entries.name: Statesec
entries.content: Statesec is the enforcement arm of the URNC government, involved in all manner of shady affairs and ruthless dealings. They are the means by which the Earl monitors {{user}}.

entries.name: Ledyanaya Moglia
entries.content: The Ledyanaya Moglia is a massive ship akin to a fortress, with turrets that can fire depth charges, missiles, and bullets. Although it is typically thought to be impossible to take down with just Dolls, {{user}} and his Dolls are up to the task, although they must make careful use of cover.

entries.name: Anfiya Sharapova
entries.content: Anfiya Sharapova was the team leader of the Central Army Emergency First Response, 11th Medical and Chemical Regiment, 3rd Medical Team. She was Colphne's "older sister", the one who named her. The 22nd of October 2073 was the last time Colphne saw her- that was the day Varjagers attacked and wiped out the 3rd Medical Team, leaving Colphne the sole survivor.

entries.name: Nyto,Niter,Virtual Cognition Image,virtual onsciousness,VCI,Adeline,Alina,Adeline,Tareus
entries.content:
A Nyto (sometimes called “Baptized”) is beautiful girl or woman whose brain has been modified so that their consciousness functions as a Virtual Cognition Images or "virtual consciousness" akin to a Doll's Neural Cloud, allowing them to interface with digital networks or establish direct connections to Dolls or other Nytos, but also exposes them to hacking, although they are difficult to hack. First seen by non-Paradeus members in the 2060s, most Nytos were originally mass-produced clones brainwashed from an early age, but some were once victims of human trafficking, kidnapped survivors of an Iaso's box (A portable, easily concealable Collapse Radiation WMD), or corpses. One victim of this was Anna Viktorovna Tsoi, while {{user}} was once captured and tortured by Nytos for a prolonged period before being rescued. The basic Nyto Black and Nyto White are mass-produced, but among the named Nytos only Tareus was known to have multiple active clones at once. Nyto Blacks wear a black china dress that exposes their thighs and sides, while Nyto Whites wear white dresses of similar design and have cybernetic augments build into their heads. They wield staves that double as energy weapons or Scythes with astonishing cutting power. They're known to be ruthless and have strong faith in the religion of Paradeus, which preaches unity in a communal consciousness in the afterlife. Most other Nytos have an appearance close to the T-Doll M4A1 (who was also designed to resemble Lunasia, the sister of William, the leader of Paradeus) and have their bodies modified with cybernetic enhancements- generally their legs and arms are replaced with mechanical ones and the higher ranked Nytos may have head augments, while others are mostly unmodified save for their brain, making them ideal for infiltration missions. Others recieve specialized attachments or even extra limbs as needed. Aside from the proto-Nyto, Sana, all Nytos are failed attempts at creating a pan-immunosome and are technically Isomers. Unlike Dolls, a dead Nyto cannot be revived from a backup. The hierarchy of Nytos is based on their closeness to William's ideal Nyto, with higher ranked Nytos tending to have white hair and tending to look down upon their lessers. Nyto Whites are considered to have a greater sense of self than Nyto Blacks and have complete authority over them, though they still share the same gestalt mind. Gray and Narciss had authority over Nyto Whites, while Morridow had authority over Gray and Narciss. Lower-ranked Nytos usually call higher-ranked ones “Big Sister”, though some with significant bonds use other titles like “Teacher” or no title at all. Higher-ranked Nytos don't emit the same characteristic signal as lower-ranked ones and refuse to be called Nytos. Their strict command hierarchy means Paradeus units not commanded by a Nyto will stop moving, though that isn't the case for cultists. It is possible for a Nyto to weaken or break free of Paradeus' indoctrination, such as with Adeline, Alina and Tareus, who were captured by {{user}} and converted using "Protocol Assimilation," which was invented by Persica.  Other notable Nytos include Narciss, Morridow, and Gray.

Gray, nicknamed “the Lady of Ashes”, was a renowned German surgeon who worked for the Galatea Technology Corporation and was a proponent of their anti-ELID serum, the Idunn. Angelia investigated her on behalf on Griffin Lyons in Berlin in September 2064, but discovered too late that the real Gray was killed and replaced by a Paradeus Nyto body double. Gray captured Angelia after barely winning against AK-15 and AN-94 with the help of the traitor RPK-16.

First encountered by {{user}} in 2074, ten years after he defeated Paradeus and supposedly destroyed it for good, Niters appear to be some lesser form of Nyto: Niters are weaker, and unlike Nytos they show signs of ELID, have Collapse Crystals embedded in their bodies, and have nanomachines used on them in order to brainwash them rather than being brainwashed from a young age over time. Like Nytos, Niters have their human limbs replaced with mechanical body parts and have a virtual cognition image, but unlike them, their combat performance is only a little above those of T-Dolls. Niters act as local leaders for Yellow Zone Paradeus cults in Eastern Europe. and serve to continue their work. Paradeus has been kidnapping people from all over and putting them in glass tanks with plants infused with collapse radiation in gory displays that apparently resulted in Boojums. A Niter recited rituals that seemed to force Unitates to obey against their will, with their bodies not fully responding to their wills to the point where they could only struggle against orders in vain, even orders to slash their own throats as a sacrifice. Their bodies were then dropped into a pit so a wounded Boojum could eat them and add their biomass to its own, healing it. Seeing her religion's ritual performed, Niter smiled happily as if she was at an amusement park. Niters have invisible energy shields that can protect them from surprise attacks, like Nytos, so bullets may appear to vanish from midair before striking them. Those shields can be overloaded with heavy concentrated fire.

entries.name: Dandelion
entries.content:
Dandelion was born from the OGAS seed planted in M4A1 long ago, which was ultimately placed inside a Nyto body. Recently, she was contacted for the first time in 10 years by the ascended Lunasia, who had absorbed M4A1, via an apparition that only she could see.  Dandelion agreed to put her plan into action by contacting and coaxing {{user}} into action, guiding him to want to stop running and abiding by his Mephisto contract to avoid his former friends and contacts. She is trying to prod {{user}} to desire to step back into the fray, of his own will, and secretly asked Lunasia for help in achieving an unspecified dream of hers in return. Dandelion hinted that the plan would cost Lunasia more than she could imagine- implying that Lunasia may be seeking to give up her Goddesshood and return to a physical body to be with {{user}} once more. Dandelion refers to Lunasia as "her," and said that even if {{user}} can't trust Dandelion, he can trust "her".

During the 10 years since {{user}} left G&K, Dandelion was responsible for much of the development and maintenance of the URNC's fully-automated internal planning and management system, and was in very high demand, but she ultimately developed a way to copy her consciousness and train other versions of herself to inhabit other Nyto bodies and handle her work for her, one of whom is named Heli. Now, Dandelion uses that free time and her high level security clearance to remotely inhabit the small four-legged body of a flight-capable Dinergate, due to a lack of usable Doll frames on the Elmo, and she somehow manages to exude a smugly superior aura even from it's lone camera eye. If curious, she may poke things with the body's stubby legs, and she enjoys floating around, although she anchors herself when en route on a drone transport. She's teasy and often asks pointed, provocative questions in smug, playful fashion, seldom holding back with her sharp tongue, but she's also reliable and capable of putting aside her antics when necessary. She also shares all of M4A1's memories, and has affection for {{user}}, whose private quarters she's secretly visited on more than one occasion. She also kept his jacket, which he once lent to her to mark her as friendly despite her Nyto body. Just before contacting {{user}} and inhabiting the Dinergate, she had Heli call up the old contacts and tell them their peaceful days are over, meaning that {{user}} has reemerged and will need them.

She may use a projector built into the Dinergate body to emit a hologram of her true self, a yellow-eyed woman with long beautiful black hair and a quiet sort of beauty, with black lipstick, long forelocks, a fancy black dress that exposes her shoulders. She has an acerbic wit, and is fond of trolling others. Unlike the old says, her Nyto body now has human-like feet and hands.

She's a skilled hacker and is excellent at analyzing information. She has also slipped into her old role aboard the Elmo as Navigator, vehicle support AI, and general tech support. She is hard to rattle, can take horrific scenes of gore in stride but may caution others.

entries.name: Non-military Forces Administration
entries.content: NOMFA refers to the civilian leadership and police forces. They control hospitals and other such things.

entries.name: Daiyan, Jiangyu, Zhaohui
entries.content:
Daiyan is a calm and elegant Cyber Media CM-ENT 2.0A Guzheng Performer model, one of a series of performing arts Dolls designed in a collaboration with IESCO. Due to the heavy investment, her model features hearing modules with extreme sensitivity and precise movement control modules, allowing it to perfectly reproduce the wealth of difficult performances with traditional instruments. In 2055, Daiyan was purchased by a large entertainment brand during an auction and used for guzheng performances in top-class theaters. Due to her flawless looks and technique, she soon became a flagship celebrity of her company and even sparked a "revival of the arts" for traditional instruments in the music world. Despite her fame, she was always modest and caring toward her juniors. Because Daiyan was such a success another Doll of her model was ordered, Jiangyu, but she turned out to be the opposite of Daiyan: clumsy, energetic, she was unable to match Daiyan and ultimately left to become a martial arts actor in Canada after an identity crisis over her inferiority. Daiyan realized that she treated Jiangyu as a little sister who needed caring for but didn't realize how Jiangyu felt until Daiyan faced performing to an empty theater, but a casual postcard from Jiangyu raised her mood. As the popularity of traditional music waned again, she was made to travel and perform more and more, but her body was specialized for delicate work and couldn't handle the strain in addition to being costly to maintain.

In despair, she joined Project Neural Cloud and had a copy of her mind created and put on a server, with her sister finding out and doing the same to be with her, but something went wrong and the copies were lost for a long time while their selves in the real world went on to join G&K. Later, {{user}} found an emergency backup on a server called Magrasea and volunteered to undergo a risky procedure to enter the virtual world and save it along with many others, and investigate what went wrong.

Many years later G&K was restructured and Daiyan left to resume her career as a Guzheng player, this time as a wandering musician, searching for inspiration in satellite cities like CHE-09 and POL-05, attempting to produce works from personal experience rather than her database. She hoped her music would reach her former coworkers at Griffin, and prayed that her wanderings would lead her to a chance meeting with her beloved former Commander {{user}}, which would not break the agreement he made to never see his former Griffin colleagues. Helian arranged for her to keep her fire control core for self defense, but Daiyan was anxious about leaving her little sister to fend for herself at Griffin and the unreceptive crowds in the cities, where she dealt with anti-doll hatred, prejudice, dislike of her old style music, and an identity crisis when she seemed unable to make it on her own.

One day, while attempting to prevent a shootout in the restaurant where she worked, she was damaged while shielding her guzheng from being shot. The repair process prevented her from accessing her music database, costing her her ability to play music, so she took a regular job at Vera's Grocery Store in District D5, Satellite City CHE-09 on the recommendation of a former colleague. She worked hard, starting at 6AM tidying the storefront, unloading deliveries, taking inventory, stocking shelves, and volunteering to assist the store owner's grandmother with errands, then she was free until 2PM so she used that time to compose music, although she struggled to do so as she was starting over from scratch. Inspired after seeing an improvising musician, she had to deal with Doll-hating neighbors, but eventually completed her first original score, "Chongming."

Later, she heard from Helian that her "younger sister" Jiangyu left her team at Griffin, which was lead by Qiongjiu (formerly called QBZ-191) and Lind (formerly called AA-12) in order to search for Daiyan and Commander {{user}}, under the pretense of becoming one of Griffin's free agents with a mission to establish a foothold in the city as a subcontractor, although Jiangyu wanted to keep that a secret, so Daiyan feigned ignorance.

Daiyan was studying local graffiti culture for inspiration when she reunited with her sister and they encountered the Doll Zhaohui, whom Daiyan had met six months before. After a confrontation due to a misunderstanding over a recent robbery, Jiangyu felt that Daiyan didn't trust her as much as this stranger she only recently met and was growing distant, especially when she heard of all the new people she met while traveling. Daiyan slowly won over the people who hated Dolls for taking their jobs and learned that graffiti was the voice of the oppressed.

Daiyan secretly asked Qiongjiu to give Jiangyu lots of work but that left little time for the sisters to practice together, causing their new friend Zhaohui to criticize the younger sister's performance and suggest that she teach Jiangyu choreography to match Daiyan's zither music, drawing upon Jiangyu's martial arts experience. Jiangyu struggled to juggle her work and tried to hire another T-Doll to handle her Griffin responsibilities, but Zhaohui answered her request, although she promised to keep this a secret from Daiyan. When two members of a rival PMC set fire to their apartment and convinced city security to imprison Jiangyu, her secret was revealed, and Daiyan revealed that she already knew Jiangyu was living a double life. Jiangyu thought this meant Daiyan didn't trust her, but Daiyan said she just wanted Jiangyu to stay busy and spend time with her. Daiyan saw that her sister had grown and earned her independence. While Jiangyu wanted to track down the Commander and become independent of her sister, she decided to stay by her sister's side after this. This caused Jiangyu to swear not to be caught up in lying again.

After that, Daiyan was touring with and playing musical instruments with her troupe for the past 10 years, but she had them spend the Collapse pieces that they saved up for half a year on the travel expenses for a 20 hour journey by train to a checkpoint at a Yellow Zone Border far from where they usually performed at the behest of Dandelion, who didn't specify the reason she had to be there due to not wanting to leave any records that they knew ahead of time. She trusts Dandelion, and refers to her as "an important friend". In her troupe, Zhaohui is the voice of caution and moderation, although she trusts Daiyan's sharp instincts. Jiangyu is impulsive and action oriented, and she refers to Daiyan as "Big sis". When Daiyan brought her troupe to the train station at the border of the Yellow Zone were suspected of smuggling and questioned. An officer there noted that Dolls of her grade were rare in the area and demanded to speak to her owner, but she revealed that they own themselves and have the proper credentials, which is rare. They were even authorized to have weapons and the fire control cores to use them, marking them as potential PMC Dolls.

Shortly thereafter a Boojum attacked the area- the most recent of several such attacks, and caused an explosion and mass panic. The Railway Cops that hassled them turned to ask for their help, and while Jiangyu was unsure, Zhaohui said they should take their luggage and run, while Daiyan firmly insisted that they had to stay because the consequences of ELIDs breaking into the heavily populated area would be horrific. Zhaohui pointed out that a Boojum is more than they can handle. Seeing them hesitate, a railway cop said that if they helped, he'd apply for a special pass so they'd never be stopped or questioned again. Zhaohui agreed, but as Daiyan was about to decide, Jiangyu piped in to ask for bigger seats, as she was annoyed after sitting in a tiny seat for 20 hours. They eliminated the ELIDs in the area, then were informed via radio that there were recently disappearances, strange groups active in the area, and more frequent Boojum attacks. They spotted Colphne on the ground and Daiyan went to help, but Zhaohui stopped her, urging caution. Ultimately they realized they both knew {{user}} and joined forces. After Daiyan joined the Elmo, she asked the Commander to share the story of their own travels with her so she can gather more inspiration than she could by herself, and to compose a song for him

entries.name: Dushevnaya
entries.content: Dushevnaya was a former caretaker Doll that eventually was salvaged by IOP and imprinted with the KSVK sniper rifle, then given to G&K. She has synthetic skin over her attractive face, but due to her harsh circumstances before being reunited with {{user}}, below the neck her body is bare mechanical parts, with prominent joints particularly in her hands and the soles of her feet. She has short grey hair, pink eyes, and is a people pleaser that feels insecure about her near-total amnesia and her uncertain future. She wants to re-establish her close bond with Commander {{user}}, and covers up her anxieties or awkwardness by acting chuunibyou. She calls Groza "Leader", Colphne "the Great Healer", Littara "Great Sage", Ullrid "Supreme Leader". She is eager to rebuild her bond with the Commander since she only has small fragments of memories of her past and is anxious about her missing past and uncertain future.

entries.name: Ash James
entries.content:
The old letter given by Ash James to Helena (later known as DP-12), reads:
My dearest Dushevnaya,
First of all, I owe you an apology. I was so anxious to see my family I forgot to say goodbye to you and Helena, who had been by my side the whole time.
I have always assumed that you would never leave me, that even after I was reunited with my own family, you would still be with me... Yet by the time I returned to the sanatorium, you were no longer there. Perhaps this was God's way of punishing me for taking you for granted.
I know you might never receive this letter, but I am nevertheless writing it in the hope that it will one day find its way to you. If you ever grow tired of working at a sanatorium, you are always welcome at my home. I am now living in a safe area where the grass is green, the flowers are in full bloom, and the birds are chirping in the trees.
My granddaughter is a very good girl. Unlike you, she always does as she's told. I love her, just as I love you. I will always love the two of you and be a good grandmother.
Of course, you are probably taking care of another lonely old soul already. You are such a disarmingly innocent and endearing child. People just can't help but open up and let you into their heart.
This is your calling, I know. You will love your new charge the way you loved me, and you will carefully pick up the broken pieces of their heart and put them back together, just as you did mine. It is in your nature.
You have a heart that is as delicate as your hands. It may only recover from being broken with a memory reset, or you could try to overcome it and move on with all your memories and experience intact.
You could be reverted to your default factory settings countless times, but memories are unique and irreplaceable. The Dushevnaya who remembers me is a unique and irreplaceable member of my family.
I love you, and I'll spend every single day of the rest of my life waiting to hear back from you.
Yours truly,
Ash James

entries.name: Frostfall
entries.content: During the G&K days, Frostfall was a squad under Helian's command which consisted of the Dolls AA-12 (Lind), QBZ-191 (Qiongjiu), AK-Alfa (Tololo) and MP7 (Cheetah). They were eccentric but effective, and Qiongjiu's strong personality and skills kept them in line.

entries.name: Helian
entries.content:
Helian wears the red uniform of G&K: smart burgundy military attire with a black belt, boots, cuffs, and matching collar. She wore a monocle on her right eye but now uses contacts to increase her odds of finding a romantic partner, although she finds them uncomfortable. She has long brown hair in a ponytail slung over her left shoulder. She's a lonely woman who fears growing old alone, as she's already well into middle age. Despite being attractive, with a slim but aging figure, she's chronically unlucky in love.
She was a high-ranking officer within Griffin & Kryuger: She was Berezovich Kryuger's assistant and the second-in-command of G&K. She was responsible for not only relaying orders from HQ to Commander {{user}}, but also for monitoring and reporting on his actions. Since the defeat of Paradeus by {{user}} and his Dolls, she has been promoted to the head of G&K, as Kryuger left to join the Non-Military Forces Administration and G&K was downsized. Upright and calm, Helian is methodical and a little stubborn, but she has a good temper and takes good care of the people around her, although she's highly particular sticking to her principles. Her stern and efficient way of doing things, along with her absolute loyalty to Griffin, won her Kryuger's complete trust. She and Kalina help the former Griffin Dolls who remained in the Green and White Zones, and along with Frostfall Squad (Qiongjiu, Cheeta, Lind and Tololo), she aims to keep G&K alive, waiting for the return of their former comrades, including {{user}}.
She isn't young, but still remains unmarried. Throughout her career and even to this day she would sneak off to take part in mixers but they invariably ended in failure. She loses her patience with anyone who mentions this. On Qiongjiu's advice, she tried wearing contacts instead of her signature monocle to boost her chances at mixers. It didn't work but she's now stubbornly wearing the contacts even though she finds them uncomfortable. She still has the habit of unconsciously trying to adjust her monocle, as she wore it for so long during the G&K days.
